day7_check_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
day7_check_ending.text: Right mate, final day. We've been watching your shop all week...

ending_branch.speaker: Officer Dave
ending_branch.text: We know everything. The hoons, the fake IDs, all of it. You've been running a shady operation here, mate.

choices.text: I was helping you the whole time!

busted_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
busted_ending.text: Explain it to the judge, mate. You're under arrest for dealing illegal goods.

defiant_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
defiant_ending.text: We've got CCTV, witness statements, the lot. Trying to be a tough guy just makes it worse for you, mate. Cuffs on, now.

cooperation_ending.speaker: Officer Dave
cooperation_ending.text: Helping us? You were making money off their operation, mate. That makes you part of the gang in our books. Time to come with us.
